create_wavernn_model: create a WaveRNN neural vocoder model with configurable architecture and training parameters
train_wavernn_step: run a single training step on WaveRNN using spectrograms and waveforms with learning rate scheduling
generate_wavernn_audio: generate audio waveforms from mel spectrograms using the trained WaveRNN model
compute_wavernn_loss: compute the negative log likelihood loss for WaveRNN given spectrograms and target waveforms
get_wavernn_complexity: get the FLOPS and parameter count statistics for the WaveRNN model components
